title: Walking skeleton: scaffold, contracts, one endpoint wired to one screen
body:
## Goal
The app starts locally and one screen shows data from one real endpoint.

## Context
SPEC.md §6–7

## Files / area
- area: infra
- creates: repo scaffold, `contracts/`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `<run cmd>` starts FE and BE
- [ ] `curl localhost:8000/api/health` returns `{"ok":true}`
- [ ] Home screen renders data from `GET /api/items`

## Out of scope
- styling, auth
